title: ActionEnvelope
description: Canonical bounded Kernel action envelope, rebuilt against the locked Master Design Package formal model (A0-T2). C1R correction (A0-U01, owner-supplied external finding): the canonical field name is `boundedParameters`, per the locked Master Design Package - it must not be flattened to top-level paramU256/paramStr. boundedParameters remains CLOSED (paramU256/paramStr only, additionalProperties false) so it carries a typed, finite, bounded action - never arbitrary calldata, selector, destination, method name or LLM-generated payload (CLAUDE.md Section 7 invariants 2-3, TM-AUTH-003/TM-AUTH-009). A narrower adapter/transport projection may be defined separately for a specific Target Adapter; it must not replace this canonical shape.

targetId.description: The registered Reclose Target this action is bounded to.

targetAddress.description: On-chain address of the protected target/adapter the effect applies to.

policyHash.description: Canonical hash of the active policy that authorized this action (RFC 8785 JCS + Keccak, ADR-010; TM-AUTH-011).

resourceId.description: The protected resource/capability this action is scoped to.

actionType.description: Finite Kernel-v1 action set (Implementation Specification). Never an arbitrary string chosen by a Reporter/LLM (TM-AUTH-003).

boundedParameters.description: Canonical closed bounded-parameter container (Master Design Package field name restored, C1R/A0-U01; mirrors PolicyDetail.effects' paramU256/paramStr fields). additionalProperties is false so no other key - calldata, selector, method, destination, payload - can ever be smuggled in under this object (TM-AUTH-003/TM-AUTH-009).

paramU256.description: A single unsigned 256-bit integer as a decimal string, or null when this actionType takes no numeric parameter. This is the ONLY numeric-parameter slot.

paramStr.description: A single short string parameter (e.g. a resource sub-identifier), or null when this actionType takes no string parameter.

decisionStage.description: Whether this action was authorized under a provisional or final DecisionRecord (CLAUDE.md Section 16). NONE is not a valid stage for an action actually being submitted to the Kernel.

decisionReference.description: Reference (e.g. incidentId+ruleId+decisionStage composite key, or decisionId lookup convenience) binding this action to the exact DecisionRecord that authorized it. Never a bare transaction hash alone, since a DecisionRecord is a semantic object distinct from its GenLayer transaction lifecycle (see DecisionView.schema.json).

nonce.description: Replay-protection nonce (TM-LIFE-*, duplicate-delivery invariant CLAUDE.md Section 7 invariant 8).
